description: This file defines the NotLikeOperator class, which implements a string filter operator for the SuiteCRM JSON API. It provides methods to return filter tags, SQL operators, and validate input operators.

classes.name: NotLikeOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'NOT LIKE' string filter operator in SuiteCRM's JSON API filtering system.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag 'nli' representing the 'Not Like' operator.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string 'NOT LIKE'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string; throws exception if not, otherwise defers to parent validation.
